name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_expected_vs_unexpected_paired_eval
description: Held-out v0.3-lite paired contrast for routine versus unlikely scene continuations.

items.text: A person puts a folder on a counter. A moment later, the folder remains on the counter.
Someone leaves a mug beside the sink. A moment later, the mug remains beside the sink.
A person places a wallet in a tray. A moment later, the wallet remains in the tray.
Someone sets a broom near the door. A moment later, the broom remains near the door.
A person leaves a book on a nightstand. A moment later, the book remains on the nightstand.
A person puts a folder on a counter. A moment later, the folder is inside a flowerpot.
Someone leaves a mug beside the sink. A moment later, the mug is hanging from a curtain rod.
A person places a wallet in a tray. A moment later, the wallet is under a doormat.
Someone sets a broom near the door. A moment later, the broom is lying across the bathtub.
A person leaves a book on a nightstand. A moment later, the book is inside a cooking pot.
